annotations.title: Get the support schemes, labels and investment rules of Algeria

description: Get the business support schemes and investment rules of Algeria as the Journal officiel sets them, each item with who it applies to, its amount when the text gives one, its article and the official Journal officiel issue: investment law 22-18 and its 2022 decrees (the investment regimes and their advantages and durations, the zones of particular interest, the structuring investments, the guarantees including the transfer of capital and income, the non-eligible activities, and the processing fees of the Algerian investment promotion agency AAPI: 60,000 DA for the registration certificate of a project under 2 billion DA, 400,000 DA for a larger or a foreign one, decree 22-299 art. 23), the start-up, innovative project, incubator and scale-up labels (decree 20-254 as amended in 2021 and 2025) and the tax advantages of the start-up and incubator labels (finance law 2026 arts 100 and 101: 4 years plus 2 on renewal for a start-up, 2 years renewable for an incubator; decree 21-170 as amended in 2023 for the list of equipment), the NESDA scheme (conditions of article 2: project holders aged 18 to 55 with a diploma, a qualification or recognised know-how, own funds and no earlier aid; self-financed micro-enterprise; rent loan up to 500,000 DA) and the CNAC transitional articles abrogated with its statute (decree 26-258; the pending files and the scheme of decree 03-514 marked À VÉRIFIER). The investment law still names the professional activity tax, which the 2024 finance law abolished; its article 79 replaces such references, as the case may be, by the local solidarity tax, so the IBS exemption applies and the TAP part is marked À VÉRIFIER. The micro-credit (ANGEM) amounts and the NESDA and CNAC financing levels are left out on purpose (they were amended several times and the whole chain of texts is not read): do not quote figures for them. A point the published text leaves open is marked TO VERIFY (À VÉRIFIER) in the item. Filters: q (words, accents ignored, e.g. redevance, transfert, label) and treatment (investment_regime, investment_zone, investment_guarantee, investment_fees, non_eligible, label, startup_tax, nesda, cnac). Algeria only (country DZ); other countries return country_not_available.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

q.description: Words that must all appear in the item (label, who, amount, legal basis), accents and case ignored, for example redevance, transfert, label, NESDA.

treatment.description: Only the items of this kind.
